punchline: A small fly etched into urinals at Schiphol, by the deputy director's account, cut spillage on the floor by 80 percent.
thirty_sec: At Amsterdam's Schiphol Airport, a maintenance worker named Jos van Bedaf proposed etching a small fly into the urinals, an idea he had picked up years earlier from a dot in a military toilet. According to deputy director Aad Kieboom, spillage fell by 80 percent. No rule, no sign, just something to aim at. The figure is the airport's own account.
